subject: Define site survey profile and release use
question_or_provisional_direction: Ore administrative 0.30 and site-reported comparison 0.40 Bq/cm² recorded. No yellowcake release default. Confirm actual loading/site purpose, authorized readings and wipe follow-up.
evidence_for_closure: Signed site profile, references, units, permitted release authority and expiry/review interval.

subject: Select smallest patch and representative photon envelope
question_or_provisional_direction: Determine minimum patch dimensions/shape, allowed alpha/beta or combined reporting basis, floor types, background range/spectra and travel speed or mission-time need.
evidence_for_closure: Written numeric challenge conditions and allowed error probabilities, standoff and worst-case geometry. Record limitations if site evidence is unavailable.

subject: Choose carry and loading arrangement
question_or_provisional_direction: Select loaded weight, CG, grip geometry, transfer height/reach and whether the local route needs a cart/dock/lifting aid. Current 12 kg figure is an allowance only.
evidence_for_closure: Representative ergonomic task assessment; sign permitted operators/transfer path. Verify on assembled unit at G2.

subject: Approve edge/access policy and recovery
status_or_current_direction: Proposed: mode-specific access and guarded elevated edge
question_or_provisional_direction: Select secured unattended and occupied shared-space arrangements. Define doorway drop protection for elevated open-door work, outside stop/recovery, safe egress and collision/trapping controls with the technician inside.
evidence_for_closure: Documented site risk assessment; floor-level mock remains the only authorized drop-test method until approved controls exist.

subject: Choose one optical stack and vendor
status_or_current_direction: Proposed: one full-size stack before four
question_or_provisional_direction: Select emitters, front thickness, guide, source of SiPM, optional classifier and upper reference. Compare optical uniformity, fixed package, lead time and true cost.
evidence_for_closure: One-pair sample and sectioned drawing; measured near/far, leakage, photon mismatch and procurement terms.

subject: Set floor working gap, pitch and protective travel
question_or_provisional_direction: Evaluate Rev D trial geometry, four 80 × 100 mm apertures at 87.5 mm pitch, nominal 10 mm film standoff and 3 mm lower bumper projection. Compare 5 mm projection for debris response and nuisance contacts. Set permitted loaded gap excursions and qualified speed by test.
evidence_for_closure: Geometry report, dynamic loaded gap histories, obstacle results, source rasters and sensitivity at the worst authorized gap; requalify after guard or suspension changes.

subject: Set head clock/timing and location error allocation
status_or_current_direction: Proposed: 100 ms bins in current ICD
question_or_provisional_direction: Allocate tolerated pose, sync and exposure error at max speed. Determine sync condition, maximum gap/latency and treatment of invalid frames.
evidence_for_closure: Signed timing error budget and bench cross-trigger record; close loop against floor landmarks at G2.

subject: Approve drive, current and independent stopping strategy
question_or_provisional_direction: Select brake/coast behavior on power loss and inclines, safe fallback and directional protection; set permitted motion set then prove under load.
evidence_for_closure: Drive stop circuit and fault analysis; maximum speed activated only after guarded stopping-envelope tests at G2.

subject: Freeze connectors, power limits and peak heater current
question_or_provisional_direction: Verify nominal battery 12.8 V, distinguish pack extremes from actual head rail. Confirm PSU, connector derating, fuses, regenerative behavior, head 10 W electronics and 30 W heater peak proposed allocations.
evidence_for_closure: Bench schematic/load trace, cold charge protection, battery/vendor limits and power-off damping or shutdown evidence.

subject: Choose operating ambient/time and thermal disposition
question_or_provisional_direction: Fix start conditions and maximum deployment time. Decide if −25 °C stretch, heat duty and ingress resistance are needed for this build. Determine acceptable component bands and recovery reserve.
evidence_for_closure: Thermal budget approved before chamber testing; qualification results at G3 establish actual operating and charging envelope.

subject: Freeze map/report and coverage semantics
question_or_provisional_direction: Define map cell resolution distinct from footprint, valid exposure, incomplete-floor display, signed estimates, release-area averaging, export/archive format and retention.
evidence_for_closure: Signed sample report, acceptance grids, generated mask examples and raw-data replay expectations.

subject: Set independent validation and recount rule
question_or_provisional_direction: Agree investigation probability, permissible false alarms per mission/area, uncertainty bounds near 0.40, speed, hotspot minimum and maximum recount duration. Freeze held-out validation plan.
evidence_for_closure: Pre-registered blind trial and statistical analysis plan with sample size, confidence method, reference method and stop/review dispositions.

subject: Freeze floor coverage path and unsupported zones
question_or_provisional_direction: Select offsets/overlaps based on measured aperture and positioning error, derive threshold approach limits, wall coverage and when a human must finish inaccessible areas.
evidence_for_closure: Independent mock floor coverage and unresolved-area plan; signed exclusions included in report.

subject: Approve component to prototype build quantities
question_or_provisional_direction: Review one pair/OEM availability, cold-rated substitutions, mass, current/heat allocations, lead times and any unresolved vendor documentation before multi-lane buy.
evidence_for_closure: Approved parts list at the revision used on test articles, bench-pass evidence, purchasing authority and required deviations.

subject: Qualify site envelope and release jurisdiction
question_or_provisional_direction: Review complete G3/G4 data and coverage, confirm site-specific decisions and minimum qualified sensitivity; name operator and independent release signatory.
evidence_for_closure: Signed evidence pack with limitations, training, site acceptance/witness and change/recalibration procedure. Otherwise retain prototype-only status.

subject: Guided visit and manual-access method
question_or_provisional_direction: Set arrival tolerance, offset and inaccessible-spot handling. Establish the local protective footprint for travel with technicians in the trailer, close-work inhibit, and clear-field/rearm/Next sequence.
evidence_for_closure: Blinded relocation and occupied guidance trials meet position tolerance, protective separation and measured stopping margin. Document unusable aisle widths and permitted directions.

subject: Unattended access protection and alerts
question_or_provisional_direction: Select door/access status mechanism and any independent stop or supervisory channel; define response to viewer, safety-link and alert-route loss.
evidence_for_closure: Site risk assessment and validated protected-area/response procedure authorize a specific unattended operating envelope.

subject: Service-power and pack-swap architecture
question_or_provisional_direction: Freeze pack latch and connectors, charger model, hardware charge-present inhibit, simultaneous service load, allowed settings and service battery/disconnect behaviour.
evidence_for_closure: Approved schematic and hazard analysis, gloved swap and full/empty/cold-pack power-path tests including unexpected charger removal.

subject: Head-controller and descriptor approval
question_or_provisional_direction: Select head MCU and descriptor/firmware versions. Define how one initial handshake associates this connection with the approved geometry and host calibration, how continuity loss revokes it and how startup prevents stale records. Select the lab harness and drive inhibit.
evidence_for_closure: Timing/live-time and extension tests plus a handshake/count capture, negative identity fixtures and loss/reset/swap/replay results.

subject: Rev D front-head dynamics and rail geometry
question_or_provisional_direction: Freeze rail profile and design clearance after loaded Rev D trials. Decide whether rigid support is sufficient or a guarded travel-limited floor-following design needs a new calibration.
evidence_for_closure: Measured head mass/moment, wheel loads, shock response, standoff envelope and radiometric trade-off across 3 mm and 5 mm rail trials.
